title: File access built from input (basic) — review required
description: A basic file operation builds its path from input: OPENs+[a-zA-Z][w$]*s+FOR. Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via an allowlist of names.
remediation: Confine with an allowlist of names or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.

tests.line: # audit: OPEN fname FOR INPUT present
